name: @animastor/web-generator
description: Generation-progress domain slice for Animastor web frontend — the pure/near-pure analysis state machine, progress panel rows, SSE event routing, and generation timer. Host capabilities (identity, transport, phase, auth, i18n, navigation) arrive via the injected ProgressRowContext and ProgressEventSink contracts; the package never imports host stores, api/client, app-level UI, or signals. Package-free domain logic extracted from the generation-progress contour.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
